interface.title: MOCS-Cert Trajectory Verification Studio (v0.1.0)
interface.field: Molecular dynamics / structural biology (computational biophysics, verifiable trajectory analysis)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and verification of simulation output: asking geometric questions of an existing MD trajectory and producing an auditable, hash-certified answer
interface.what_it_is_for: Write a declarative distance/contact query against an MD trajectory, compile it through a nine-stage plan that prunes and refines time blocks with conservative AABB bounds, and check the hash-certified result next to a Mol* 3D view of the structure.

data.note: Bundled demo data: synth_500f.xtc/.gro (500 frames, 10 atoms, 80 Å orthorhombic box, 50 MCI leaf blocks) is the default trajectory. Bundled structures 4HHB, 1BNA and 1TUP, plus a 13-entry catalog (including 1STP and de novo RFD-BINDER-01, PMPNN-DES-42, BOLTZ-COMP-01), load from RCSB or local presets. The page offers no upload. Queries run on synth_500f. Loading 1BNA as the dataset made queries end in MISSING_DATA/ERROR. The run loaded 1BNA through the catalog at trace step 71 and did not reload the page until step 141, so screens 031–057 were captured in that 1BNA state.

tree.general: Find out whether a geometric condition between two groups of atoms holds anywhere (or everywhere) in a simulation trajectory, and get an answer that can be checked independently
tree.specific: Run a MolQL distance/contact query on synth_500f, inspect the pruned and refined dyadic timeline lattice, verify the SHA-256 execution certificate, and look at the witness in Mol*

features.name: Declarative query editor with presets and run diagnostics
features.general: Type or load an example question in a small query language, run it, and see a structured success or error message with a suggested fix
features.specific: MolQL editor with Golden Query Presets, Compile & Execute (Ctrl+Enter), Query Diagnostics panel, and PARSE_FAILED / INVALID_SELECTION cards with an Action hint
steps: Pick a preset or type FIND (sel) WITHIN dA OF (sel)
Open Query Diagnostics to see stage, execution ID, query hash, dataset
Press Compile & Execute or Ctrl+Enter
Read the result badge, or the error card with location and corrective action
serves_tasks: Load a ready-made example question
Write a custom question by hand and run it from the keyboard
See how the tool rejects a badly formed question
Ask a contact question between two residue groups instead of single atoms

features.name: Staged execution plan with metrics
features.general: Show a computation as an ordered list of named stages that tick to completed, with summary efficiency metrics underneath
features.specific: Nine-stage Execution Plan table (Scientific Query → … → Offline Validation Probe) plus the MCI Execution Metrics card (refinement selectivity, I/O prune ratio, traversal depth)
steps: Run a query
Watch the stage statuses go from Pending to completed
Read the Soundness Verified badge and pruning metrics
serves_tasks: Load a ready-made example question

features.name: Three-state timeline lattice with drill-down and refinement
features.general: A timeline of fixed time windows coloured true/false/undecided; click a window to see its lower/upper bounds against a threshold, and split undecided windows into finer pieces
features.specific: Temporal Lattice (240 blocks, True/False/Unknown/Selected) → Block N Subdivision cards → sub-block L/U/threshold with Bound Relationship → Refine Block; Refinement Explorer shows the same as a parent/children tree; ArrowRight moves the selection
steps: Click a coloured block on the timeline (or use the arrow keys)
Pick a sub-block card
Read L, U, threshold and the certified-true/false/straddles verdict
Press Refine Block on an UNKNOWN sub-block to bisect it
Check the new child states
serves_tasks: Pick a time window on the timeline and read its bounds against the threshold
Split an undecided window into finer pieces until it can be decided

features.name: Hash-stamped result record with integrity checks and export
features.general: Show the JSON record of a computation, run a set of integrity checks on it, copy its hash, and download it for offline checking
features.specific: Execution Certificate (JSON) with SHA-256 / Soundness badges, Verify Certificate / Run Verification Gate (hash integrity, source digest, MCI Merkle root, semantics, non-expansion), Copy SHA-256, Export Certificate
steps: Run a query so a certificate is generated
Open Execution Certificate or Formal Audit
Press Verify Certificate / Run Verification Gate
Copy the SHA-256 or press Export Certificate to download the JSON
serves_tasks: Verify the hash-stamped result record and copy its fingerprint
Run the integrity and invariant checks on the result record, compare against a reference tool, and export the record

features.name: Reference-oracle differential table
features.general: Line up this tool's per-frame values with an independent reference implementation and show the difference
features.specific: Oracle Differential (MDAnalysis): per-frame MOCS bound [L,U], MOCS materialized distance, MDAnalysis oracle distance, discrepancy Δ
steps: Run a query
Open Formal Audit ▸ Oracle Differential
Read per-frame discrepancies and the 100% Bit-Exact badge
serves_tasks: Run the integrity and invariant checks on the result record, compare against a reference tool, and export the record
Read the supporting evidence: bounds, I/O savings, reference-tool agreement, logs

features.name: 3D structure viewer with bounding-box overlay and frame stepping
features.general: Show a molecule in 3D, switch drawing styles and layers, overlay the bounding box used for a calculation, and step through trajectory frames
features.specific: Mol* Molecular View: structure preset strip, Cartoon/Sticks/More (Surface, Backbone, Spheres), Layers (protein, AABB, Measurement line), AABB toggle with Selection / Block 41 / Global Envelope modes, Fit / focus buttons, Persp/Ortho camera, satisfying-frame player
steps: Pick a structure preset (e.g. synth_500f)
Choose a representation
Toggle AABB and choose an envelope mode
Tick layers such as Measurement line
Step frames with the player and watch the distance update

Load another structure from a catalog and change how it is drawn

features.name: Result inspector / evidence summary panel

Read the verdict badge
Check the Query Contract matches the question asked (quantifier, operator)
Read the evidence counts and pruning percentage
